Package io.jans.fido2.model.telemetry

Class NativeClientTelemetry

java.lang.Object
io.jans.fido2.model.telemetry.NativeClientTelemetry
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class NativeClientTelemetry extends Object implements Serializable
Optional client-supplied context a native app/SDK may attach to an attestation or assertion start/finish call, carrying detail no User-Agent string can (Play Services version, OEM Credential Manager behavior, the last client-side error code, ...). See issue #14607.

Every field is optional and its absence must never change ceremony behavior — this class is pure data, never validated against a fixed set of values. platform/nativeApi/ flowContext are documented as a closed set (android|ios, credential-manager| asauthorization|legacy-fido2|webview, native|webview|system-browser) but are plain strings here: an unrecognized value must still deserialize and persist, not reject the ceremony request over a telemetry field the client got wrong.
